item.tib: yang snying gsang ba'i thugs sgrub las gnad bskul lha srin dam bsgrags
item.coloph: ces pa'i gnad bskul lha srin dam bsgrags 'di ni/ rgya rong brang steng dmar po ri nas rdo yi sgrom bu'i nang du zangs kyi mkha' 'gro'i brda ris yod pa gsang sngags gling pas gter du spyan drangs nas/ sgrub gzhung tshogs 'khor yan chad brag steng rgyal sar ru phab pa la/ srung zlog sogs cha tshang 'di ni phyis su bya rdo sku zhog dang waM lo sku zhog tshe dbang mchog sprul dge bshes lha sras bla ma thams cad dang / gter grogs dbang mo dang mchog sprul g.yung drung nyi rgyal g.yung dbal sogs nye gnas grwa 'khor yongs kyi sgrub skor tshangs ma phab dgos bskul ba las bston gnyis gsang sngags gling pas mkha' 'gro'i brda yig dge bshes rgyal saMr dag pa phab ste bkra shis//
